sum: SandRidge Energy, Inc. engages in the acquisition, development, and production of oil and natural gas in the United States Mid-Continent region. As of December 31, 2025, it holds interests in 1,446 gross (825 net) producing wells, and one active drilling rig. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.
ceo: Mr. Grayson R. Pranin Jr. (President, CEO & Director)
